releaseNotes:
Is update mein kya naya hai:

1) Item search mein naya item wahin se banayen - Sale aur Purchase ki item search list par naya button 'Add New Item (F3)'. Agar likha hua naam list mein na mile to neeche laal hint aata hai; Enter ya F3 dabane par Item form khul jata hai jis mein naam pehle se bhara hota hai. Save karte hi item seedha invoice ki list mein aa jata hai - dobara search karne ki zaroorat nahi.

2) Item form mein Company aur Category ab lazmi nahi - khali chhor kar bhi item save ho jata hai.

3) Line Item yaad rehta hai - Item form kholne par wohi Line Item pehle se select hota hai jo pichli baar save kiya tha (program band karke dobara kholne par bhi).

4) Article No ka column - item search list (Sale / Purchase) aur View Items Record mein Code ke saath ab Article No bhi nazar aata hai.

5) Article No se search - har item search (Sale / Purchase picker, View Items Record, Return list, Rate List) ab Article No se bhi item dhoond leti hai.

6) 'Starts With' item search ab Sale / Purchase search par bhi lagta hai - Management > Sale Screen mein option 'Use Starts With item search'. On karne par jaise jaise naam shuru se likhen waise list narrow hoti hai (NE likhne par ACNE ya NEEM nahi aayega, sirf NE se shuru hone wale items). Off (default) par purani search - naam mein kahin bhi.

7) Dashboard par Items card par click karne se View Items Record khul jata hai.

8) Shop Information + System Configuration screen ab screen ke beech mein khulti hai.

Update Date: 12-09-2026
